rows.note: Use 用 as the all-purpose equivalent when something is used as an instrument or means.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 faai3 zi2 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use 同 before a person for company, and in solidarity expressions when English means being on someone’s side.

example.english: I have dinner with my friends.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use 有 + N when describing something as having an accessory, feature, or possession.

example.english: This phone comes with a camera now.
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 waa2 jau5 soeng2 gei1 laa3

rows.note: Use 就 + N + 嚟講 when talking about or taking N into account.

example.english: With regard to price, this phone is quite good value.
example.traditional: 就價錢嚟講，呢部電話幾抵。
example.jyutping: zau6 gaa3 cin2 lei4 gong2 ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 gei2 dai2
